title: Eligibility for Filing a PDS Complaint

facts.summary: A beneficiary can raise a complaint when they experience a problem related to PDS services, ration distribution, beneficiary records, or an authorized Fair Price Shop. The applicable grievance procedure is determined by the concerned State or Union Territory.
who_can_complain: PDS beneficiaries who experience a problem with an applicable PDS service.
Eligible ration-card holders or beneficiaries affected by a ration-distribution issue.
A person who needs to report an applicable Fair Price Shop or PDS-related grievance, subject to the concerned State/UT procedure.
eligible_issues: Problems related to a Fair Price Shop.
Issues concerning beneficiary services or applicable PDS entitlements.
Other PDS-related grievances accepted by the concerned State/UT grievance system.
facts.complaint_requirement: The complaint should concern an actual PDS-related issue and should contain accurate information about the problem.
facts.required_information: The applicable grievance system may request beneficiary, ration-card, transaction or other information needed to process the complaint.
facts.authority: The concerned State or Union Territory Food and Civil Supplies authority manages the applicable PDS grievance process.
facts.online_availability: The availability and eligibility requirements of an online complaint facility depend on the concerned State or Union Territory.
facts.state_specific: The exact categories of eligible complaints, required information and submission procedure can differ between States and Union Territories.
important_notes: Do not assume that every State/UT has identical complaint eligibility rules.
A complaint should relate to an actual PDS service or distribution issue.
Do not provide a State-specific eligibility rule unless the applicable State/UT is known.
Use the official grievance mechanism of the concerned State/UT.
Provide accurate information when submitting a complaint.

faqs.question: Can I file a complaint about my ration?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you have experienced a PDS-related problem such as non-receipt of entitled ration or an issue with ration distribution. The applicable procedure depends on your State or Union Territory.

faqs.question: Who can file a PDS complaint?
faqs.answer: A beneficiary affected by a PDS-related service or distribution issue can generally raise a complaint through the applicable State/UT grievance mechanism.

faqs.question: Can I complain about a ration shop?
faqs.answer: A Fair Price Shop-related issue can be raised through the applicable official grievance mechanism of the concerned State or Union Territory.

faqs.question: Can I complain if I did not receive my ration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Non-receipt of entitled ration is a PDS-related issue that can be reported through the applicable official grievance mechanism.

faqs.question: What issues can I complain about in PDS?
faqs.answer: Applicable complaints can include problems with ration distribution, non-receipt of entitled ration, Fair Price Shop issues and other PDS-related grievances accepted by the concerned State/UT.

faqs.question: Do I need a ration card to file a complaint?
faqs.answer: The information required to file a complaint depends on the concerned State/UT grievance system. The system may request beneficiary or ration-card details.

organizations: Department of Food and Public Distribution, Government of India
